outline:
這堂專業英語課程將以英語討論、辯證政治和公共決策議題。課程內容將取材自傳統傳媒和社群媒體之時事。
This ESP (English for specific purposes) class focuses on engaging students in discussion of politics and public policy in English. Class materials will be drawn from traditional news platforms as well as social media.

scorePolicy:
Course Requirements
Students’ responsibilities in this class include:
1. Attendance and Participation – Regular attendance and active engagement in discussions are required.
2. Case Study Presentations
Each student (or group) will be assigned a business case focused on marketing and consumer markets. Presentations must include key insights, strategic challenges, and potential solutions. Students must provide a summary handout before their presentation.
4. Reflection Report
Students must submit a comprehensive case analysis report (4-7 pages) summarizing key takeaways and/or integrating insights from multiple case studies covered in class.

Semester Grading Policy
1) Topic Reading and Speeches 40% (Choose TWO for public speaking)
2) Debate 30% (Public Forum Debate)
3) In-Class Discussion & Reflection Paper 20%
4) Attendance 10%

Attendance Policy
Students are required to attend all class sessions on time.
Each absence will result in a 10% deduction from the final semester grade.
A university-approved leave document may waive one absence penalty per semester.
AWOLs (absences without leave) will be recorded and included in the penalty calculation if not rectified within two weeks.
The instructor reserves the right to modify this syllabus. Any changes to the grading policy will be discussed in class.

resources:
● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
● 混成學習 (Blended Learning)
課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。
Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
